name: Bathsheba
summary: The daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite, whom David took while Uriah was at war. She later became David's wife and the mother of King Solomon.

key_moments.title: Seen from the Rooftop
key_moments.description: From his roof King David saw Bathsheba washing herself. He sent for her and lay with her, and later she sent word that she was with child.

key_moments.title: Gives Birth to Solomon
key_moments.description: After their first child died, David comforted Bathsheba, and she bore him a son named Solomon. The LORD loved the boy and sent word through Nathan to call him Jedidiah.

key_moments.title: Speaking for Solomon
key_moments.description: Nathan sent Bathsheba to remind the old king of his oath that Solomon would reign after him. David swore again that Solomon would sit on his throne that very day.

key_moments.title: Brings Adonijah's Request to Solomon
key_moments.description: Adonijah asked Bathsheba to ask King Solomon for Abishag as his wife. Solomon set a seat for his mother at his right hand, but he refused her request.
